title: Complete Spain (ES) VAT configuration and category rate mapping

requirements.summary: Mark Spain (ES) as fully configured in the EU VAT country configuration with correct VAT rates and reverse-charge text so the calculator enables ES.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts, the ES entry has a non-zero standardRate, a non-empty reducedRates array (when applicable), a non-empty reverseChargeText, and configured is set to true.
Spain no longer shows "Configuration Pending" messaging in the VAT country details/transaction steps and the "Start Calculator" action is enabled for ES.

file_operations.description: Update the ES (Spain) configuration: set standardRate to Spain’s standard VAT rate, populate reducedRates with Spain’s reduced and super-reduced rates, provide a non-empty Spain-appropriate reverseChargeText, and set configured=true (keep changes confined to this VAT config module per constraints).

requirements.summary: Add explicit Spain (ES) VAT category-to-rate rules so selecting a VAT Category computes Spain-appropriate reduced/super-reduced rates or falls back to standard.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRules.ts, Spain ("ES") is handled explicitly (e.g., within computeVatRateForCategory switch) and returns Spain-appropriate reduced rates for relevant categories and the standard rate for non-eligible categories.

When the selected country is ES, the VAT Category selection influences the effective VAT rate shown/used by the calculator (i.e., reduced categories result in a reduced rate and standard/others remain at the standard rate).

file_operations.description: Extend computeVatRateForCategory to explicitly handle countryCode === 'ES' by mapping relevant VatCategory values to Spain’s reduced and super-reduced rates (and returning standardRate for non-eligible categories). Keep all rule logic changes confined to this existing VAT rules module.

Wire VAT Category selection into the effective VAT rate calculation for ES by using computeVatRateForCategory when vatTreatment is standard (while preserving existing overrides for reverse charge/exempt and the existing reduced-treatment selection flow). Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui.

requirements.summary: Ensure Spain’s reduced rates integrate with the existing reduced-VAT treatment UI and are used consistently in the VAT calculation results.
acceptanceCriteria: When ES is selected and the user chooses reduced VAT treatment, the UI offers Spain’s configured reduced rate options and uses the chosen rate as effectiveVatRate for calculations.
VAT results for ES reflect the selected reduced rate (vatRatePercent in the result matches the chosen reduced rate) and gross/vat amounts update accordingly.

file_operations.description: Ensure reduced VAT treatment for ES uses the ES reducedRates from euCountryConfig and reliably sets/keeps selectedReducedRate and effectiveVatRate so downstream calculation results use the chosen reduced rate; verify the effective rate display aligns with the selected reduced rate when vatTreatment='reduced'.
